name: voxflow
description: VoxFlow — AI voice CLI as a skill for any AI agent. Bundles 6 skills (hub, podcast, transcribe, video, slice, card) that drive a hosted TTS / ASR / podcast / render backend.

plugins.name: voxflow
plugins.description: AI voice CLI bundled as 6 skills. TTS in 200+ voices across 40+ languages, multi-speaker AI podcasts, audio/video transcription with word-level timestamps, SRT-driven dubbing, end-to-end video translation, long-article → vertical card video reels via Remotion, and turning text into polished shareable card images or narrated card videos. Backed by a hosted TTS/ASR/LLM/render service with per-user quota (free tier 10K/mo).
